data_fields.name: markerHalfPx
data_fields.donor_constant: max(20, H/25) windowed; 6 + 10 x HRES05/128 in cockpit

best_idea: Draw each threat as a box when on screen; when off screen, fall back to a small arrow with its name and distance instead of hiding it.
decision_why: A three-attacker fight needs off-screen threats shown; the donor's centred arrow, missing behind flag and divide-by-zero are changed (moved to the rim in the adaptation).
acceptance: With three attackers, an on-screen target gets a box with name above and distance below; an attacker behind the camera gets a rim arrow with a behind tag; an attacker on the camera axis gets no arrow and no NaN (unit test: chevron(0,0,1) returns null).
